Hi all — confirming Redwood's formal position and process.

1) VAT / Invoice evidence
- Our invoicing entity for EU customers is Redwood Inference Ltd (UK-registered). VAT ID: GB999 9999 77.
- For EU reverse-charge, we will issue an invoice showing net VAT with wording: "VAT reversed under Article 44/196". Please retain the payment trace for your records.

2) Intermediary (correspondent) bank fees — policy and timing
- Preferred: Customer sends the gross invoice EUR amount so Redwood receives the full invoiced amount. This prevents short payments and simplifies accounting.
- If the payer's bank deducts an intermediary fee mid-route (result: Redwood receives net):
  * The customer should supply the MT103 / SWIFT remittance advice to billing@redwood.ai within 14 days.
  * Upon receipt, Redwood will issue a credit memo for the intermediary fee amount and apply it to the next invoice cycle (typical processing time 30 days).
  * If the intermediary fee is material (> EUR 50), we can expedite reimbursement; please mark the email "URGENT: Intermediary fee reimbursement".

3) If customer intentionally sends NET (i.e., instructs bank to deduct fees from the transferred amount):
  * Redwood will not automatically gross-up the invoice. We'll need written prior agreement and will apply a gross-up fee to cover operational reconciliation. We do not recommend this approach.

Examples (plain text):
- Invoice amount: EUR 10,000
- Customer sends gross 10,000; intermediary fee EUR 20 deducted in transit; Redwood receives 9,980. With MT103 provided, Redwood issues credit of EUR 20 applied to next invoice.
- Customer sends net 9,980 (instructed), Redwood treats as short payment of EUR 20 and will require either immediate top-up or apply our reconc/fee process.

Action items for Oliver:
- Please send the gross EUR 10,000 to the IBAN Tessa listed.
- If your bank informs you that a correspondent fee will be charged en route, request the MT103 and forward it to billing@redwood.ai.

Marissa — once we receive MT103, can Billing produce a credit memo template we can share with the customer?

Thanks,
